target.title: perf(ui): add virtual scrolling to file preview modal code viewer
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The file preview modal in Skill Workshop renders entire file contents as a single giant `<pre>` text node. For large support files (up to 256 KB / ~5000 lines), the browser struggles to layout and paint this monolithic DOM node, causing severe lag and freezing when scrolling through code.

Fixes #99062

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace the single `<pre>` element with a virtual scrolling approach:
- Only lines visible in the viewport (plus a 30-line overscan buffer) are rendered as individual `<div>` elements
- Spacer elements maintain correct scrollbar dimensions
- Scroll events are throttled via `requestAnimationFrame`
- A `ResizeObserver` recalculates the visible range on container resize
- Scroll state resets when switching files or filtering

For a typical 256 KB file with ~5000 lines, DOM nodes drop from 1 giant text node to ~70 lightweight `<div>` elements.

## User Impact

- Scrolling through large code files in the preview modal is now smooth
- No visual change to the UI — identical appearance, better performance
- File list sidebar navigation is unaffected

## Evidence

- `ui/src/ui/components/file-preview-modal.test.ts` — all 4 existing tests pass without modification
- Manual verification: built UI with `pnpm ui:build`, deployed to gateway, confirmed smooth scrolling

### Changes
- `ui/src/ui/components/file-preview-modal.ts`:
  - Added virtual scrolling with fixed line height (22px) and overscan (30 lines)
  - Added `handleCodeScroll` with rAF throttling
  - Added `recalcVisibleRange` for computing visible line range from scroll position
  - Added `ResizeObserver` for container resize handling
  - Added `connectedCallback` / `disconnectedCallback` for lifecycle cleanup
  - Replaced `.pre` CSS with `.code-line` and `.code-vscroll` styles
